title: Aoyagi Toya — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few hours later
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you all have your cookies and drinks?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! All set!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Without further ado...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. You made so many cookies... They look delicious.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The coffee you made for us smells great, too! And it's poured right from the carafe, too! How classy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. Part of the appeal of a vacuum coffee maker is in its presentation, after all, so I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Try a cookie too, Toya! I made the star-shaped ones myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Len, that's not fair!
Toya, try my musical note cookies too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will. You made them in so many different shapes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO let us use her collection of cookie cutters.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was a lot of fun using them all together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It really is a nice feeling, sharing coffee and snacks with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not bad once in a while. Though this isn't all we've got planned either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ahem! Attention, please! It's time to begin today's entertainment!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I present to you... The SEKAI Trivia Tournament!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Trivia tournament...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start by explaining the rules!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There will be a total of 13 questions! We'll go round-robin on announcing each question.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Write your answers down on these whiteboards. We have a special prize ready for whoever gets the most questions right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I am fairly confident in my trivia knowledge, so I intend to win here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, look who's confident. We're not holding back just because it's your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nor would I want you to.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start us off! Let's see who gets this one right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which genre of music, born in the United States, combines the rhythms of swing with improvisation?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I know this one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “The rhythms of swing” is a big hint.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, everyone's done writing! The answer is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Jazz! Was it a little too easy, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just right for the first question, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think so too. And the connection to the United States was appreciated, too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, my turn! Mine's pretty hard, so everyone be ready.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm, it looks like Miku is in the lead right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have seven points, and next is Toya with five, I think.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len's trick question tripped me up. I couldn't help but overthink it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry, Toya. Looks like I'm winning the crown today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are still three questions left. I haven't given up just yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The battle is heating up. Just in time for a very important announcement!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This just in: These last three questions will be special questions!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Special questions?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll find out what's so special about them at the answers! Kohane, take it away?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Special question number one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What are the named roles in musical theatre called?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The named roles in musical theatre...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I recall hearing about this from Kusanagi during Shibu Schools Fest...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, I don't know if I know this one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a pretty hard one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, it looks like everyone's finished writing. So, the correct answer will be read by... A special guest!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <We'll be the ones announcing the correct answer! Go for it, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Um, the answer is 'principal role'. Did everyone get it right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Did you get it? And also! Toya! Happy birthday!!!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Happy birthday. You're in the United States right now, right? When you get back, I'd love to talk to you about composing again.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <I'd be interested to hear about the US, myself. I have a present for you too, so I'll give it to you when you get back.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <This has been your special guests! Keep on battling for the high score!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Saki... And Hoshino and Kusanagi, too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane asked them for a trivia question and a special video for you. Pretty surprising, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It certainly was. I didn't expect to receive a video message...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have more special questions too. While you're thinking of the answers, try to guess who they're from!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The next question is... What photography technique involves intentionally loosening the focus to create blur?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Photography...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Could it be...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looks like everyone's done. This answer is brought to you by...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <The correct answer is 'soft focus'. I believe that's the technique Kohane used when she took those modeling photos of Aoyagi.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It was probably pretty simple if you know your cameras... What did everyone think?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also... Happy birthday, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I'm so glad we can send you our best wishes even when you're so far away. I hope your birthday has been lovely.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I know you're in the US studying for your music career, but you can take it easy for today, at least. See you again sometime!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that was from Haruka and friends! Who got it right... Just Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's all thanks to Azusawa telling me during the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That ties the rankings, I think. Is the next question the last one?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's right. So whoever gets it right is the winner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the final question! Trumpets can have various coatings. Which lacquer produces the most powerful sound?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Trumpets, huh? That reminds me of when Toya helped with that instrument event and practiced with one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was just with the mouthpiece, really. To think that experience would serve me now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hm, no, these questions are likely...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone done? Okay, here's the answer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heya, Toya♪
Enjoying your birthday party?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Here's the answer for this one, from the two who thought it up!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um, the correct answer is gold lacquer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This one was a little hard, so we included a hint in there. Did everyone get it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I sure didn't! But if you think about the colors, then you could make an educated guess, so it's a pretty solid question!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, once again! Happy birthday, Toya♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Happy birthday. I hope it's a good one.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The last question was from Mizuki and friends! Toya and Rin got it right, and so did Len and Luka. Which means...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The winner of the SEKAI Trivia Tournament is... Toya Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Congratulations, Aoyagi! And here's your prize!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is...a wristband?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! You can wear it during shows, and it's understated enough to wear in daily life too, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is. Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Congrats, Toya. I was so close...but you beat me fair and square.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, those special questions...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, never mind. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Having so many people send me their well-wishes... I truly am fortunate.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And thinking back, I've made memories with so many people.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Each one is precious to me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I want to continue treasuring the connections I build with people... And the memories I make with them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya! Are you enjoying your American birthday?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Japan and America are really far apart from each other... But I'm sending happy happy birthday waves all the way there to you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to celebrate with a super-long-range birthday cannon as well, but sadly, the technology is only theoretical at this stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To make up for it, we'll welcome you home with a truly fantastical spectacle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! We'll merge your welcome home party with your belated birthday bash! We'll have a special show waiting for you too, so look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Toya! Did you solve the question we...by which I mean Kanade and Mafuyu, came up with?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You seemed very knowledgeable about trumpets, so maybe it was a little too simple in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I only helped with that one question... But I hope you had fun with the game.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We've got presents for you when you get back! Enjoy the rest of your stay in the US with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Aoyagi. Given the occasion, I thought a question related to a memory we shared would be best. How did you like it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your photos really turned out great that day, Toya. You, Azusawa and Kiritani worked so well together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The bond you share with Kohane truly came through in the photo as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's have another group photoshoot someday. We don't even have to be rivals this time, either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. That might be fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Toya. Keep on doing your best out there with Akito and the others!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Aoyagi. It's a strange feeling, sending a video message to a friend all the way in the United States.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're over there to see the real thing when it comes to your style of music, right? I'm sure being around all those people will be an amazing experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It makes me want to do more for us, too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya! When you get home, let's compose together again! And go out for food with Tsukasa! Hehehe, I have so many fun plans ready!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It looked like you really enjoyed the trivia contest. It was fun having all of us write messages on your new wristband, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I think you did sort of see through our special question idea, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what happens when you ask people for questions specifically based on their memories with Toya. Still, it made for a good look back, I bet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think so too. It makes me want to think of trivia questions based around our memories, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's fun! I really wanna make some super hard questions, ones Toya might be right on the edge of forgetting about!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't decide where to start. There's too much to pick from.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, happy birthday, Toya. Let's keep on getting up on stage, building up our experience... And someday, stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Today was so much fun. I got to try my hand at a vacuum coffee maker, and the cookies everyone made were delicious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't expect them to come up with a game just for me. I'll have to send my thanks to the special question guests, too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And to all of you who sent me happy wishes for today, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My team and I will keep on chasing our dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I promise to keep on bringing you the greatest music I can.
